subject.title: fix(plugins): bound marketplace manifest file reads

question: Should local marketplace sources intentionally stop accepting symlinked manifest paths as part of this hardening change?
rationale: The memory bound is clearly desirable, but the selected helper also imposes a broader fail-closed local filesystem policy that current behavior and public local-path support do not establish.

options.title: Preserve local compatibility
options.body: Use bounded reads for every source while retaining current local symlink behavior and enforcing strict regular-file checks for untrusted remote material.

options.title: Adopt strict local paths
options.body: Reject symlinked local manifests too, with explicit owner approval and upgrade-facing documentation or proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve local compatibility
recommendation.body: Use bounded reads for every source while retaining current local symlink behavior and enforcing strict regular-file checks for untrusted remote material.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the shared loader that owns the local-versus-remote source boundary affected by this choice.
